atomic_facts.fact: Hagenauer GmbH is registered in the Handelsregister (commercial register) with the legal form Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung (GmbH).
The seat of Hagenauer GmbH is in Immenstadt.
The stated business purpose (Gegenstand) of Hagenauer GmbH is to act as a general contractor (Generalunternehmer), planning and constructing objects of any kind.
The purpose particularly concerns upscale hotels, healthcare facilities, and office buildings.
The purpose includes the complete outfitting (Gesamtausbau) of cruise liners.
The purpose includes all business areas related to the aforementioned activities.
